releases.body:
## [0.51.0](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/compare/desktop-v0.50.0...desktop-v0.51.0) (2026-10-28)


### Features

* **desktop:** open Insert Path at the cursor, on Option-; ([4b9a190](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/4b9a1909bc81e88744dc0dafd7d76abc7b517706))
* **desktop:** preview each theme as you move to it in Select Theme ([0228f62](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/0228f626d35772fa51d8a2d7baef4825096ea14c))
* **desktop:** sidebar agent rows say what each agent is doing ([#1839](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/1839)) ([90a452a](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/90a452a1bb87d87e22a9bac24ea1714e9b69e6ee))
* **desktop:** switch sessions from a list dropped from the session button ([3ad4dfe](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/3ad4dfe61e15e50bd106dacf430fa7bd9721b7b5))

Desktop: Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized.

macOS: download phux-desktop-0.51.0-macos-arm64.dmg, open it, and drag Phux.app onto Applications. The ZIP is for automatic updates. Apple silicon macOS 26 or later; Ubuntu 24.04 GNU/Linux x64 and arm64 (X11 and Wayland; release qualification uses X11 with lavapipe). Recent DMGs include the phux CLI and server; older releases may require the separate CLI installer (https://phux.sh/install). Existing CLIs and running sessions are not replaced.

Windows x64: native desktop, WSL coordinator.

Install with the per-user PowerShell installer: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-phux/phux/main/scripts/install-desktop-windows.ps1 . The portable ZIP includes the same installer and the MSVC runtime. Requires an initialized WSL distribution with phux; signature verification requires minisign on Windows PATH or in WSL.
